pages.text: {{hero}} can swim fast in the ocean. {{hero}} has a pal. It is a shark with a big fin and a soft grin. The shark is kind and fun.
The shark wants to find a lost bell on a ship in the sand. {{hero}} and the shark set off. Swish, swish, swish!
But the ship is in a thick clump of kelp. The bell is stuck in the kelp. {{hero}} tugs, but the kelp will not let go.
Then the shark swims in quick spins. Swish, swish! The kelp spins and lifts. The bell drops in {{hero}}'s hand. Ding, ding! {{hero}} and the shark grin.
At dusk, {{hero}} is in bed. The bell sits on a shelf. But then, ding, ding, the bell rings! Not {{hero}}, not the shark. What rang the bell?
